coverLetter: I am excited to apply for the Frontend Developer position at ALGOTEQUE for your aviation industry project. With 7+ years of experience building scalable web applications—including hands-on React and TypeScript development—I am confident in my ability to contribute to your team from day one.

At Blue Creator Agency | Kimia Group, I delivered front-end solutions for internal CMS platforms and consumer-facing apps in the monetization/adTech space, resolving 120+ Jira tasks while translating Figma designs into pixel-perfect, responsive UIs. I also migrated 40+ Vue components from Vuetify to Tailwind, reducing bundle size by 19% and improving LCP performance.

At BSE America, I architected RESTful APIs with OAuth2/Laravel Passport authentication for a CRM/CMS that served as a back office solution for a WooCommerce store. This experience gives me deep expertise in secure API authentication patterns and back-office system architecture.

At EncodeBiz, I spearheaded React front-end development for a padel tournament system using TypeScript and Redux. I also implemented SSO, authentication, and RBAC for the admin dashboard—experience directly relevant to your authentication and authorization requirements.

I am passionate about clean code, component reusability, and collaborative development through code reviews. The fully remote B2B arrangement aligns perfectly with my experience working across distributed teams in Spain, Panama, and the US.
I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my React expertise, TypeScript proficiency, and REST API experience can support ALGOTEQUE's aviation project. Thank you for considering my application.
